subject.title: [Bug]: Hallucination Loop — Agent Generated Irrelevant Multi-Thousand-Word Responses Across 2 Simultaneous Sessions

question: Should this issue stay as a distinct Telegram/session-state bug, be folded into an existing Telegram delivery/session tracker, or be treated as expected shared-DM configuration behavior?
rationale: The evidence supports a real incident and a source-visible shared-DM boundary, but the missing raw payloads mean automation cannot choose between config guidance, runtime routing, reconnect/delivery recovery, and semantic loop policy.

options.title: Keep As Distinct Incident
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers can separate DM scoping, delivery recovery, and semantic runaway-output behavior with live Telegram proof.

options.title: Fold Into Existing Trackers
options.body: Move the remaining evidence into the closest canonical Telegram/session reliability issue if maintainers decide the semantic loop is a symptom of that root cause.

options.title: Classify As Configuration Boundary
options.body: Close only after a maintainer confirms shared-DM `main` scope explains the cross-chat behavior and docs/onboarding already give the supported isolation path.

recommendation.title: Keep As Distinct Incident
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers can separate DM scoping, delivery recovery, and semantic runaway-output behavior with live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision spans core routing/config defaults and Telegram session behavior, and local blame plus project-policy context make this the strongest routing candidate.
